name: mirage
text: From your report: the phone was making its own calls to Unabated, PinnWire, ParlayAPI, PropLine and Novig (hundreds), and Unabated's reply ran it out of memory at 20 MB. That is the phone doing a full fair-odds scan for Kalshi itself. I'm stopping the phone from ever running that scan while the GitHub engine drives (it will only read the engine's list).
